name: drain_graph
reviewed: wave-1 adversarial review x2 (muse-spark + deepseek-v4-flash); findings manually verified against realized code before adoption
producer: WF-1 src/jaladhar/drainage/graph.py::stitch_components (deterministic, CPU-only); config keys in configs/drainage.yaml resolved at startup (rule 7)
consumers: WF-2 coupling (node_state, edge routing, surcharge return)

grid.canonical_grid: 3515x3421 @10m - rasterized exports cropped via Grid.assert_aligned, exact crop no resampling
grid.rasterization_rule: burn cells whose CENTER is within 5 m of geometry, buffered grid only

stitcher_rules_pinned.snap_tolerance_adjudication: pinned to 10.0 m (= 1 cell) matching the realized census basis 365 comps / 1376 nodes @10 m reproduced by two independent implementations; sensitivity recorded: 372 @0.5 m. Tolerance IS part of graph identity - manifest records it.
stitcher_rules_pinned.snap_rule: endpoints within Euclidean distance <= snap_tolerance_m (UTM metres) form one node; union-find over snapped endpoints
stitcher_rules_pinned.d8_hit_definition: observed reaches rasterized to buffered grid; walk hits when entering a cell of a DIFFERENT component's footprint; re-entering own reach footprint = self-hit abort
d8_walk_stop_conditions: pointer code 0 or nodata -> outfall(outfall_reason=pit), connector written
cell outside buffered grid -> outfall(outfall_reason=domain_exit), connector written
entry into different component footprint -> junction node at entry cell, connector written
re-entry into same reach footprint -> abort, self_hit_count++
walk length > max_connector_steps=10000 -> abort, dropped_connector_count++, NO edge written
stitcher_rules_pinned.direction_rule: per observed reach walk D8 from BOTH endpoints; from_node = endpoint whose walk reaches the other; if neither reaches, from_node = higher elev_m at snapped cell; tie -> lexicographic (x_m, y_m); connector direction = walk direction; direction_confidence=low if walk traversed synthetic flat cells (wang-and-liu 0.001 m increments inside retained basins)
stitcher_rules_pinned.parallel_edge_dedup: dedupe on (from_node,to_node,order): keep observed over synthesised; among observed keep longer reach; record dropped_edge_count + dropped_edge_ids in manifest
stitcher_rules_pinned.degenerate_edge_policy: self-loops (from==to) dropped+counted (self_loop_dropped_count); post-snap length < 0.05 m or null slope dropped+counted (zero_length_dropped_count); consumers refuse load if either count nonzero
stitcher_rules_pinned.topology: final directed graph MUST be acyclic; stitcher applies documented break rule (drop lowest slope synthetic in cycle) until acyclic; manifest carries graph_is_dag=true + cycle_break_count

determinism.node_id_sort_key: (round(x_m,3), round(y_m,3)) ascending, ids 1..N contiguous after sort
determinism.adjacency_json: keys and neighbor lists sorted; explicit schema {nodes:{node_id:{x_m,y_m}}, edges:{edge_id:{from,to,order,edge_source}}, topo_order:[...], cycles:[], dropped:{self_loops:[],zero_length:[],duplicates:[]}}
determinism.rerun_stability: identical inputs (sha256) + git SHA + configs/drainage.yaml => byte-identical gpkg+adjacency; manifest records node_id_map_sha256 + graph_fingerprint (sha256 over sorted edge list)

required_fields: elev_m:float DEM-sampled at node cell from data/interim/terrain/dem_conditioned_postbreach.tif BUFFERED grid - invert PROXY, derived, labelled, never null

capacity_bearing_fields_observed_only: width_m:float primary 6.71 secondary 4.88 tertiary 2.285 nominal midpoint of [1.83,2.74]
width_basis:text embedding ft->m derivation chain incl exact rounded width ('primary 22 ft = 6.71 m' etc, BBMP norm via Times of India 2016-08-02 chain)
n_basis:text paired via allowed table {0.013:'CPHEEO 2019 Ch5 concrete as-new low', 0.015:'CPHEEO 2019 Ch5 open-concrete design', 0.030:'CPHEEO 2019 Ch5 unlined/grass high'}
q_capacity_nom_m3s:float = safety_factor * q_capacity_full_m3s, safety_factor in [0.85,0.95] CPHEEO Ch5
q_capacity_low_m3s q_capacity_high_m3s:min/max over joint parameter box {n in [0.013,0.030], C in [0.65,0.80], width in band, climate_uplift in [1.10,1.30]} at corners

capacity_basis:text JSON object with keys {width,shape,side_slope,assumption,n,slope,depth,design_return_period_yr,climate_uplift,runoff_C,safety_factor,sources[]} every value non-empty sources[] entries contain http-or-document-name; declared assumptions use key 'assumption' with one-colon values 'assumption:<label>' e.g. 'assumption:side_slope_1H1V'
measured_geometry_all_edges: length_m:float>0 measured walk/reach geometry - REQUIRED on ALL edges including synthetic connectors (NOT part of the NULL set)

slope_m_per_m:float>=0 finite measured from conditioned DEM endpoints post-snap - REQUIRED on ALL edges (null-slope drop policy applies to observed edges only; synthetic connectors always carry measured slope from their D8 path)
drain_edges.synthetic_connectors: ALL capacity fields NULLABLE and NULL for synthetic_connector edges - a D8 walk is a routing conduit only, carrying invented hydraulics violates rule 1. capacity_basis text = 'synthetic connector: no surveyed cross-section; routing conduit only, no capacity claim'. Consumers skip NULL-capacity edges for capture.

units_and_conversion.graph_stores: q_capacity in m3/s; areas in m2 and ha; NEVER mm/hr
units_and_conversion.conversion_ownership: WF-2 coupling adapter owns conversion; both formulas contractual: sink_mm_per_hr = q_capacity_m3s * 3600000 / contrib_area_m2 ; rate_m_s = q_capacity_m3s / contrib_area_m2
units_and_conversion.contrib_area_pin: depth-solve contributing area = contrib_area_cells at edge from_node (headwater), resolving research-vs-schema desync

manifest_guarantees_producer_writes.connectivity: D8_stitched AND component_count_post_stitch == 1 else refuse load (>=1 was vacuous - any non-empty graph passes, the exact Phase-1 #15a class; producer STOPS and reports for owner adjudication if post-stitch > 1 rather than shipping a disconnected graph)
manifest_guarantees_producer_writes.component_count_pre_stitch: int census at snap_tolerance_m=10.0 exactly (realized P+S: 365)
manifest_guarantees_producer_writes.elevation_surface_sha256_binding: WF-1 MUST load data/processed/buffered/elevation.tif with sha256 == 46dff442a73945f4bb8d7ee01352eefe4bdfb801b88ac0fa6b5c97d830f56fe7 (the surface ALL Phase-3 evidence consumed: replay1, replay2, calibration; promoted 2026-08-24 from p3-final scratch per owner adjudication; witness docs/elevation-surface-witness-2026-08-24.json @ c0a4fa3). DO NOT build D8 flow direction on any other elevation bytes - the superseded 1430eed3... surface would put the drain graph on a different surface from every existing finding. V1 rationale: a manifest-status field is DECLARATION; the SHA is REALIZED state. SILENT-SWAP WARNING: the two surfaces share dims/CRS/transform/nodata/valid-count and differ only in values (328,441 cells / mean 1.761 m / max 4.504 m) - only the SHA catches it.
manifest_guarantees_producer_writes.dem_source_manifest_status: REPLACED by elevation_surface_sha256_binding per owner adjudication 2026-08-24 (V1: manifest status is declaration, SHA is realized state). Terrain-conditioning adjudication RESOLVED: ACCEPT the interim postbreach artefact (failed conditioning run wrote nothing - fail-closed working as designed); the separate question of whether the 349-cell retained-basin guard is a real defect or too strict is investigated OFF the critical path (run cost ~59.6 s)
manifest_guarantees_producer_writes.pointer_provenance_caveat: pointer predates its stage-manifest overwrite; provenance code-path+mtime - recorded as known_gap
counts: synthesised_fraction_of_total_length float[0,1] RULE-1 HEADLINE if >0.5 owner informed pre-presentation
manifest_guarantees_producer_writes.capacity_rule_version: 'rational+Manning design v1: Q=C.i.A/360, A=contrib_area_ha at from_node, i per CPHEEO Ch1 return-period x uplift 1.10-1.30, C in [0.65,0.80], Manning n=0.015, nom=safety_factor(0.85-0.95) x q_full'
manifest_guarantees_producer_writes.assumed_uncalibrated_flag: coexists deliberately: legacy prior flag stays on the LEGACY drain_capacity artefact; THIS manifest declares capacity_basis instead - solver assert_drain_manifest_contract amended (WF-1 task) to accept either legacy prior OR new basis form
manifest_guarantees_producer_writes.graph_fingerprint_serialization_pinned: sha256 over UTF-8 JSON array, one entry per edge sorted by edge_id: [from_node, to_node, order, round(length_m,6), sha256(wkb_hex)] with json.dumps(..., separators=(',',':')) - byte-exact recomputable by consumer
manifest_guarantees_producer_writes.node_geometry_assumption_note: elev_m is DEM proxy not surveyed invert - consumers must not treat as pipe invert
manifest_guarantees_producer_writes.enum_forward_design_note: node_type 'inlet' and outfall_reason 'lake_boundary' are forward-design enum members: wave-1 stitcher rules produce only junction and outfall(pit|domain_exit); producers must not emit inlet/lake_boundary until WF-2 boundary-exchange agreement lands

consumer_assertions_at_load: edge_source=='synthesised' <=> order=='synthetic_connector' both directions else refuse
no from_node==to_node; length_m>0 all edges; self_loop_dropped_count==0; zero_length_dropped_count==0 else refuse
graph_fingerprint recomputes over loaded edges else refuse; deterministic_ids==true

on capacity-bearing edges: (n_manning,n_basis) in allowed pairs; width_low<=width_m<=width_high; width_basis contains exact rounded width_m 2dp (V10 numeric-basis consistency); q_low<=q_nom<=q_high all finite >0

capacity_basis parses as JSON object, all values non-empty, CASE-INSENSITIVE check: no value v satisfies 'assumed' in v.lower() UNLESS its key starts with 'assumption' and value matches one-colon form 'assumption:<label>' (catches Assumed/ASSUMED/assumed_uncalibrated while allowing declared assumption:side_slope_1H1V); sources[] non-empty with http-or-doc-name each; depth=='solved:rational+Manning'; safety_factor in [0.85,0.95]

data/processed/buffered/elevation.tif sha256 == 46dff442a73945f4bb8d7ee01352eefe4bdfb801b88ac0fa6b5c97d830f56fe7 else refuse (elevation surface identity is REALIZED state per owner adjudication 2026-08-24; the superseded 1430eed3... surface is NOT what Phase-3 evidence consumed; witness docs/elevation-surface-witness-2026-08-24.json)
rationale: Grounded in realized recon: P+S=1033 reaches (163+870), 372 comps @0.5 m / 365 @10 m two independent implementations agree; vertex order 50.05% downhill coin-flip so direction exclusively D8 under pinned rule with confidence grading; tertiary default EXCLUDED pending owner adjudication (5815 geoms in 4443 components, only 121 junction candidates into P+S) but enum supports additive inclusion; widths cited BBMP norm via ToI 2016-08-02 chain; n cited CPHEEO 2019 Ch5 with numeric-text pairing enforced; depth solved not assumed; slope measured; connectors capacity-less (rule 1); V8 seam mechanical via manifest fields + load assertions, every assertion has a red path (V5) and named observable (V2).
open_questions: Tertiary inclusion: RESOLVED EXCLUDED per owner adjudication 2026-08-24 (4,443 components / 121 junction candidates = >97% of tertiary graph would be invented); enum stays additive if ever revisited
Lake-boundary outfalls: provisional node_type=outfall/outfall_reason=lake_boundary, discharge target deferred to WF-2 boundary-exchange agreement

Terrain conditioning: RESOLVED per owner adjudication 2026-08-24 - ACCEPT interim postbreach artefact (sha 46dff442..., promoted with manifest runs/promote_phase3_elevation/manifest.json); 349-cell retained-basin guard defect-vs-too-strict question investigated SEPARATELY, off the critical path (~59.6 s run)
wf1-drain-graph.js quotes stale census figures ('373 @0.5 m ... 370 @10 m') - repoint at pinned 365@10m / 372@0.5m before WF-1 dispatch

capacity_confidence_semantics.width_provenance_grade: BELOW CPHEEO confidence - width norm is a news-sourced BBMP survey figure (single ToI-origin chain), NOT a design-manual table; width_basis carries this downgrade explicitly; every capacity number inherits it
capacity_confidence_semantics.undetermined_rule: capacity sensitivity band spans x[0.45,1.9] = factor 4.2; ANY downstream verdict (gate pass/fail, surcharge vs not, segment flooded/not) that flips within this band is reported as UNDETERMINED, never as a point result
